_doctrine: R-023: the baseline contract. Deck 1 BEATS = what a PLAIN tutorial on this concept would minimally need (derived from the concept, not the inventory); each beat is a ROLE cast with one artifact (alts = understudies). Deck 2 VOLTAGE = the few pieces a plain tutorial would never include -- the critical script, the thinker with QFEP. Everything uncast is AT DEPTH: kept, honored by the dig line, not needed by the book or the walk.

voltage.why: the same rotation rule per layer yet exponential divergence — the birthday cake as a lesson in how uniform law breeds unequal motion, celebration turned unstable.
order matters — T1∘T2 ≠ T2∘T1 made walkable; non-commutativity as the political fact that sequence is not neutral, that who-acts-first changes the world.
walk a corridor where each segment rotates a little more — local repetition accumulating into a global twist you inhabit rather than observe, transformation as architecture around the body.
the QFEP core — move a thing without changing what it IS; the invariant is the queer question of identity under transformation, what persists when everything measurable shifts.

voltage.after: prove it — match a target pose
voltage.why: the goal is not motion but stillness — mastery proven by the system coming to rest, transformation judged by the invariant it finally leaves standing.
